title: UtilityHub
description: Title slide — One toolkit. Every calculation.
speakerNotes:
- Open with energy: "One toolkit. Every calculation."
- Hook: 50+ tools across 8 categories in a single app
- Hit the differentiator early — all in-browser, no account, no data leaves your device
- Set the frame: this is about consolidation + privacy, not just another calculator site
- Transition: "Let me show you why this matters."

title: The Problem
description: Scattered tools across dozens of websites
speakerNotes:
- Paint the pain everyone recognizes: new tab, ad-filled site, unfamiliar form, repeat
- Three failure points: fragmented UIs, untrustworthy hidden formulas, data sent to unknown servers
- Gesture to the cluttered domain list on the right — "this is everyone's bookmarks bar"
- Emphasize the trust + privacy angle, not just inconvenience
- Transition: "What if all of this lived in one place?"

title: The Solution
description: Everything in one place, nothing leaves your browser
speakerNotes:
- Deliver the promise: everything in one place, nothing leaves your browser
- Anchor on the three numbers: 50+ tools, 8 categories, 0 data sent to servers
- Stress that consolidation and privacy come together — no tradeoff
- This is the core value prop slide; slow down and let it land
- Transition: "Here's what's actually inside."

title: 8 Tool Categories
description: Finance, Health, General, Developer, PDF, Image, Converters, Business
speakerNotes:
- Sweep across all 8 categories: Finance, Health, General, Developer, PDF, Image, Converters, Business
- Don't read every tool — name the breadth, point out a favorite per category
- Make the point: covers everyday consumers AND professionals
- Tease that the next slides go deeper on the standout categories
- Transition: "Let's zoom into the ones people use most."

title: Finance & Health
description: Deep calculator suite for real decisions
speakerNotes:
- Frame these as calculators for real decisions, not quick conversions
- Finance: EMI, mortgage, SIP, compound interest, retirement, GST, income tax
- Health: BMI, BMR, calorie & water intake, body fat, heart rate zones, pregnancy
- Use the EMI ($50k @ 8.5% = $1,022/mo) and BMI (22.4, normal) cards as live proof
- Transition: "Now the power-user side."

title: Developer & PDF
speakerNotes:
- Position for professionals: no installs, no plugins — open and use
- Developer: JSON/XML formatter, JWT decoder, Base64, UUID generator, regex tester
- PDF: merge, split, compress, rotate, OCR, sign, watermark, Word export
- Point to the JSON formatter and UUID cards as instant, familiar examples
- Q&A prep: PDF/OCR all run client-side — files never leave the device
- Transition: "Beyond calculators and dev tools…"

title: Converters & Business
description: Universal unit conversion and business document generators
speakerNotes:
- Converters: currency, length, temperature, weight, area, volume, speed and more
- Business: invoice + quotation generators with PDF export, salary, profit margin
- Highlight the business generators — they turn UtilityHub into a real work tool
- Note the export-ready output: usable deliverables, not just numbers
- Transition: "And it travels with you — on mobile."

title: Mobile Companion
description: iOS and Android app built with Expo
speakerNotes:
- The full toolkit in your pocket — native iOS & Android, built with Expo
- Three pillars: native performance, offline-capable, same trusted calculations as web
- Point to the phone mockup — identical tools, same speed
- Reinforce: one codebase, consistent experience across web and mobile
- Transition: "All of this rests on one principle — privacy."

title: Privacy by Design
description: All processing runs in the browser — zero data sent to servers
speakerNotes:
- The closing argument: every calculation runs in-browser via WebAssembly + client-side JS
- Hammer the three stats: 0 bytes uploaded, 0 accounts required, 100% in-browser
- No server, no tracking, no account — privacy isn't a feature, it's the architecture
- Q&A prep: this is a genuine moat vs. ad-funded competitors who monetize data
- Transition: "So here's how to start."

title: Try UtilityHub
speakerNotes:
- Close confidently — restate "One toolkit. Every calculation."
- Recap the three takeaways: 50+ tools, web & mobile no account, processing stays on device
- Clear single CTA: visit utilityhub.app — nothing to install, free to try now
- Invite questions and offer a live demo of any specific tool
- End on the privacy promise as the lasting impression
